safetyBoundary: Communication practice only. Facility policy, assigned supervisors, product labels, PPE training, and infection-prevention direction govern actual work. Instrument reprocessing and sterilization are outside this EVS course.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Introduce yourself as EVS staff to a nurse and confirm your assigned area in English.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Introduce yourself to a Spanish-speaking EVS teammate and ask where they are assigned.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Identify the charge nurse, supervisor, and EVS lead; ask who can answer a question.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Distinguish nurse, supervisor, and EVS lead in Spanish and route a question politely.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask where a patient room, supply room, and nurses station are.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Give a coworker simple directions to a room and the supply closet.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Confirm a shift start, a room number, and a handoff time without guessing.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Ask a teammate when a room assignment begins and repeat the time back.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Name a cart, cloths, gloves, and a sign; ask for a missing supply.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Ask for common supplies and clarify which cart belongs to the unit.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask a nurse or patient for permission to enter and respect a request to wait.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Ask politely to enter an occupied room and acknowledge a request to return.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Warn someone about a wet floor and say whom you will notify.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Give a clear wet-floor warning and ask a coworker to alert the unit.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask for slower speech, repeat an instruction, and identify what is unclear.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Ask a Spanish-speaking teammate to repeat a room request and confirm the meaning.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Say you found an unfamiliar hazard and ask the assigned supervisor before touching it.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Report an unfamiliar hazard in Spanish and request the local procedure.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Give a short end-of-task update: done, pending, and who was told.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Receive a simple handoff and restate what remains pending.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Confirm an occupied-room cleaning request with the nurse and patient.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Explain an occupied-room request to a Spanish-speaking EVS teammate.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask when to return if a patient needs privacy or rest.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Acknowledge a patient's request for privacy and coordinate a return time.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Distinguish occupied, discharge, and unavailable room status in a handoff.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Clarify whether a room is occupied, vacated, or still unavailable.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask which surfaces are in the assigned checklist rather than inventing a list.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Discuss high-touch surfaces and confirm the facility checklist in Spanish.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask whether shared equipment belongs to EVS or another team.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Clarify responsibility for shared equipment with a teammate.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Report clutter or a blocked area and request help before proceeding.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Describe an obstacle in a room and ask who can clear it safely.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Confirm that the patient has left and that the room is released for EVS work.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Pass along a discharge-room assignment without claiming clinical release authority.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Report completed checklist items and ask who verifies room readiness.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Give a precise completed-versus-pending room status to the unit.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask whether a shared bathroom is available and how to redirect visitors.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Explain a temporary bathroom closure and direct someone to ask staff.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Request replacement supplies and report an empty dispenser.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Tell a coworker which bathroom supplies are missing without assuming brands.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask which product and checklist apply to a particular bathroom surface.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Clarify the assigned product and surface with the EVS lead in Spanish.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Report a leak or broken fixture and ask whom to notify.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Describe a broken fixture and request maintenance follow-up.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: State what bathroom work is complete and what is blocked.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Receive and restate a bathroom handoff without marking unfinished work done.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask the circulating nurse whether EVS may enter the OR.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Confirm OR entry permission with a Spanish-speaking teammate after the nurse responds.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Clarify whether the request is between-case or terminal room cleaning.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Distinguish between-case and terminal cleaning assignments in Spanish.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask who handles a device or instrument instead of moving it without authorization.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Tell a teammate that an instrument needs the assigned clinical or reprocessing team.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Report a missing approved product and ask the supervisor for the next step.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Describe a supply shortage and avoid substituting an unapproved chemical.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Explain a delay factually and ask the nurse for the next priority.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Update a Spanish-speaking coworker on a delayed OR handoff.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Report EVS task status and ask who authorizes the room for the next case.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Separate EVS completion from clinical room-release authority in Spanish.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Read an isolation sign aloud and ask the nurse about required precautions.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Ask a Spanish-speaking lead to confirm the room-specific precautions.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask which employer-provided PPE is required for an assigned task.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Request clarification on PPE from the assigned supervisor.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Describe a spill without guessing its contents and request the local response.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Report an unidentified spill and ask whom to notify before cleanup.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Warn others about a sharp object and notify the responsible staff without touching it.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Give a clear sharps warning and request the facility-approved response.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask how the facility classifies an unfamiliar waste item.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Clarify a waste-stream decision without asserting a universal bag color.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Report a full or damaged container and ask the assigned team to respond.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Identify a full container and route the issue to the proper team.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask where the approved product label and facility instructions are.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Request the approved label and avoid guessing a dilution or contact time.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Report a possible exposure promptly, state known facts, and ask for the employer procedure.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Give a factual exposure report in Spanish and request immediate supervisor guidance.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Confirm a changed room priority and say which prior task remains pending.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Clarify a supervisor's new priority and repeat the pending task back.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Write a concise task log with completion, exception, and notification.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Read a Spanish task log and ask about an unexplained exception.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Summarize patient room, bathroom, OR, and hazard handoffs to the next shift.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Give a structured Spanish handoff across four hospital work areas.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Resolve conflicting room-status messages without assuming permission to enter.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Compare two room-status reports and ask the unit for a definitive update.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Acknowledge a patient's concern, state EVS limits, and notify appropriate staff.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Respond empathetically to a complaint and route it to the care team.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Describe a damaged surface and explain why the supervisor needs to assess it.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Document a damaged surface and request facilities or supervisor review.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Receive a re-clean request without blame and clarify the specific finding.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Ask for the precise re-clean concern and confirm a follow-up owner.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Handle pressure to declare a room ready before EVS checks are complete.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Explain unfinished checklist work and ask for a safe priority decision.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Coordinate a shared bathroom closure with unit staff and visitors.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Explain a bathroom closure and ask staff to help redirect users.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Report a recurring bathroom issue with time, location, and prior notification.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Summarize a repeated fixture or supply problem for the next shift.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Discuss a checklist discrepancy with a supervisor using specific observations.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Ask a supervisor to review an uncertain bathroom quality finding.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Reprioritize OR assignments after a schedule change and confirm the nurse's instructions.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Explain an OR schedule change to a teammate and confirm task ownership.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Stop before moving an item near a sterile field and request clinical guidance.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Clarify that EVS does not reprocess instruments and ask the nurse to direct the issue.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Challenge an uncertain product or label instruction and escalate to the EVS lead.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Explain why an unverified product instruction requires supervisor review.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Decline to report an unfinished OR as complete and give an accurate status.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: State clearly what remains unfinished before clinical room release.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Report an OR near miss without blame, distinguishing observation from assumption.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Give a factual near-miss report and ask where to document it.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Pause when a room's precaution status changes and seek current instructions.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Confirm a changed precaution sign with the nurse and EVS lead.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Escalate a large or unfamiliar spill without choosing a procedure yourself.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Describe a spill's location and observed facts without guessing its contents.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Politely stop an unsafe or out-of-scope request and ask for the responsible team.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Decline an out-of-scope task and redirect it to trained personnel.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Give a time-ordered account of an exposure concern to the supervisor.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Make an exposure handoff with known facts and unanswered questions.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Ask a new teammate to repeat an assigned checklist and identify gaps.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Guide a Spanish teach-back while deferring procedures to employer training.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Prioritize a shift handoff spanning a patient room, bathroom, OR, and hazard report.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Give a multi-area handoff that distinguishes complete, blocked, and urgent.

lessons.englishTargetBrief: Write a factual incident summary and identify who received the report.
lessons.spanishTargetBrief: Deliver a concise Spanish incident summary with facts, timing, and next owner.
